prompt: Explain the store's refund policy for a return within 30 days.

baseline_examples.text: You can return any item within 30 days of purchase for a full refund, as long as you have the original receipt.
Our refund policy allows returns up to 30 days after you bought the item, provided the receipt is included, and you'll get your money back in full.
If it has been less than 30 days since your purchase, you are eligible for a complete refund by presenting the original receipt.
Returns are accepted within a 30-day window from the purchase date, and a full refund will be issued if the original receipt is provided.
As long as you return the product within 30 days and bring the receipt, we will refund the full purchase amount.

rejected_examples.text: You can return items within 90 days for store credit only, no cash refunds.
rejected_examples.notes: wrong window and wrong refund type

rejected_examples.text: Sorry, we do not offer refunds on any purchases.
